title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash fba55fd42a6c… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: The OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors detected a malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash fba55fd42a6cb14c417c3922d09fbcd105bdce13aff48ef908e6a201174a535d. This file was observed three times on October 29, 2026, associated with attacker activity using the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer). The file is linked to a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool delivered during the attack. The attacker infrastructure was located in Romania (RO). There is no information about known exploits in the wild or affected software versions.
